title: Global solutions of the 3D inhomogeneous incompressible viscoelastic system without structure assumptions
summary: In this paper, we prove the global existence of strong solutions for the inhomogeneous incompressible viscoelastic system without any additional structure assumptions on $\mathbb{R}^{3}$.
